breaking.change: Fit-min takes literal reflected type-step names, not a custom-property namespace shortcut. CSS spring timing is reflected with grammar and an extension reason; unresolved motion variables no longer name engine timing presets.
breaking.fix: Use -og-fit-min: caption (or another reflected step), and transition-timing-function: -og-spring(350ms, 0.3). Author variables can substitute these values normally. Spring duration must be non-negative and bounce finite. Material and sound remain reflected CSS extensions with their existing grammars and reasons.
